summary: The fix meets the STD-1 requirement: all four judge-reproduced reversals and the widened seam scope now have exact-element tests matching the cruise-override Q1 acceptance, but the new --base narrowing of the Branch PR lookup diverges from FR-004 and the validation and task docs are stale.

findings.summary: The Branch PR lookup now adds `--base <default-branch>`, so an open same-repository PR whose head is the run's branch but whose base differs is not found and item 3.2 creates a second PR.
findings.evidence: spec.md Key Entities 'Branch PR: the pull request whose head is the run's branch'; FR-004; SC-002. SKILL.md:159 filters by --base. The fork case is handled by isCrossRepository alone. Same narrowing in contracts:8, data-model:7, DESIGN.md:233, plan Summary.
findings.fix: Drop `--base <default-branch>` and keep isCrossRepository false as the same-repository filter across all artifacts; needs fresh protected scope confirmation since --base is part of accepted same-repo-lookup scope. Or amend FR-004 and the Branch PR definition.

findings.summary: Item 3.3 does not say what happens when the lookup after the second creation error finds a PR.
findings.evidence: FR-005, FR-006. SKILL.md:162 'None: retry creation once; after a second error with a lookup still finding none, halt with the creation error.' has no found/failed outcome for the post-retry lookup.
findings.fix: State post-retry outcomes explicitly: found reuses, failed halts with lookup error, none halts with creation error; mirror in contract and DESIGN.md.

findings.summary: DESIGN.md validation entry names six elements and the removal-only rule; test and contract now guard eleven elements with removed-or-reversed copies.
findings.fix: Update DESIGN.md:380 to list the eleven elements and the removed-or-reversed injection rule.

findings.summary: Checked tasks T001 and T003 still prescribe the superseded lookup command and element set.
findings.evidence: tasks.md:20 and :45-46 give the old lookup; shipped SKILL.md:159, contract:23 and test:23 use --base and isCrossRepository.
findings.fix: Reconcile T001/T003 text with the contract or add a dated supersession note. Documentation only.
